source_isolation.runner: AST isolated actual profile_cfg/reposition/profile_duration/p1_profile/p5_gap_windows/start_stream; no runner import/constructor or SITL
source_isolation.oracle: byte-extracted native valid-read, complete stale/fresh/capture branches and actual target/recovery methods; actual TargetProfile/RecoveryTarget/SampleClock headers; transport/parameter/publication stubs
source_isolation.independence: separate Python guard/reset adapter; checker imports neither generator nor empirical diagnostician. Reuses retained exact PD and A primitives; not full native binary equivalence or two independent raw-log readers
source_isolation.single_reference_origin: actual source runner messages, no manually duplicated ramp/hold reference
source_isolation.transition_order: read -> stale/capture -> target/recovery transition -> SampleClock; capture may occur before duplicate rejection

startup.timing_scope: actual named sensor/module values at LAST inference before first confirmed stream read. Source-allowed callback class starts from this declared pre-read state; profile native bound is later, not substituted for exact monotonic start. This is not an exact historic clock replay
startup.set: recorded center + lateral position .01*zp and lateral q .1*zq; both parameters in [-1,1]; velocity at actual recorded center
startup.FIFO: proxy empty history; first source/body e,d fill earliest sample; at k<22 repeat that sample. No fabricated physical prehistory or native FIFO identity
startup.prestream_scope: source module invariant/activation checks; compressed prelude is not proof of entire prestream body/GRU timing history
startup.unmodelled_memory: GRU/previous action/motor/estimator effects remain in the conditional residual interface, never zero by default

first_failure.scope: failure of linear unsaturated certificate, not a proof of tilt failure
first_failure.proof: ||v_xy|| >= |v_l_fixed|/sqrt(c^2+s^2) > sqrt(2); at T0 target velocity=0, at least one native clip axis exceeds 1 for every capture yaw
first_failure.position_reset_scope: not needed for refusal; no post-reset position enclosure claimed

prefix_proof.logic: exact rational P/difference/output inequalities, full initial two-parameter box plus conditional P-ball disturbances, summed center/generator rounding; clip inclusion checked before each use of unsaturated A
prefix_proof.post_failure_trace: full clipped nominal source/model reconstruction retained; generator columns thereafter are rejected candidate data, not an accepted enclosure

empirical_error.state_mapping: p/v/errors from research_timing named local position sample and reconstructed actual active target; q=-g R_body_z_xy/Rzz rotated into target-yaw frame, using EXACT named attitude_sample
empirical_error.alignment: native gyro sample time, not DDS UTC or line-profile seconds; require all 24 rows 4ms and fixed yaw
empirical_error.scope: 7196/7196 is sample diagnostic; six portable rows independently recomputed with rational quaternion mapping and rho enclosure. No empirical maximum promoted to hard bound

closed_for_declared_class: actual source profile and held-reference generation
proxy deterministic startup and exact finite lateral prefix refusal
conditional_or_unclosed: exact historic monotonic/native alignment and all actual callback phases
actual controller residual and output/quantization interface; mapped P9 dev01 refutes old w
full nonlinear saturated set propagation after first capture
real intersample attitude, height and full task costs
